definitions.title: Scalar Line Integral with Respect to Arc Length
definitions.latex: \int_C f(x, y, z) \, ds = \int_a^b f(x(t), y(t), z(t)) |\mathbf{r}'(t)| \, dt
definitions.statement: The line integral of a continuous scalar function f along a smooth space curve C parametrized by r(t) on [a, b] is the limit of Riemann sums weighted by arc length subsegments ds = |r'(t)| dt.
conditions: C is smooth: r'(t) is continuous and non-zero
definitions.explanation: If f = 1, computes the arc length of C; if f is mass density delta, computes total mass of thin wire C.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Integrates scalar distributions along one-dimensional curved paths in space.

definitions.title: Center of Mass of a Curved Wire
definitions.latex: M = \int_C \delta \, ds, \quad \bar{x} = \frac{1}{M}\int_C x\delta \, ds, \quad \bar{y} = \frac{1}{M}\int_C y\delta \, ds, \quad \bar{z} = \frac{1}{M}\int_C z\delta \, ds
definitions.statement: The center of mass of a physical wire shaped along curve C with linear mass density delta is determined by normalized first moments with respect to arc length.
definitions.explanation: Computes physical balance coordinates for curved geometric filaments.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Directly extends planar and solid mass formulas to space curves.
